scripts.ready: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js ready
scripts.summary: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js summary
scripts.serve: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js serve
scripts.worker: npm run build --silent && node dist/scripts/plan-scheduler.js worker
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.release:check: npm run guardrails && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run smoke:package
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test --test-timeout 120000 tests/package-smoke.test.mjs tests/validation-contracts.test.mjs tests/scheduler-mutations.test.mjs tests/cli-goldens.test.mjs tests/worker-runtime.test.mjs tests/git-footprint.test.mjs tests/visualizer-renderer.test.mjs tests/regressions.test.mjs tests/doc-examples.test.mjs tests/complexity-guardrails.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:core: npm run build && SPG_TEST_USE_ORIGINAL_DIST=1 c8 --all --src dist/scripts --include "dist/scripts/graph-traversal.js" --include "dist/scripts/node-mutations.js" --include "dist/scripts/graph-io.js" --include "dist/scripts/cli.js" --include "dist/scripts/worker.js" --include "dist/scripts/visualizer.js" --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --report-dir=coverage/core --temp-directory=coverage/tmp --clean --check-coverage --per-file --branches 65 --functions 80 --lines 0 --statements 0 node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout 120000 tests/package-smoke.test.mjs tests/validation-contracts.test.mjs tests/scheduler-mutations.test.mjs tests/cli-goldens.test.mjs tests/worker-runtime.test.mjs tests/visualizer-renderer.test.mjs tests/regressions.test.mjs tests/doc-examples.test.mjs
